findings.text: When the URL has an empty netloc (e.g. a relative URL like URL('/path').replace(port=8000) or replace(username='u')), hostname is '' and `hostname[-1]` raises IndexError. Before the change the code used self.hostname, which gave '' and did not crash.

The hostname is now taken from the raw netloc, which keeps its original case. The old `self.hostname` was lowercased. Mixed-case hosts such as 'EXAMPLE.com' therefore keep their case after replace(port=...). IPv6 hosts also keep their brackets, which can change the output format.
